# Tapir commands: Keynote Commands

The 9 commands of this group, with their parameters, results and examples. Every group and how a command is sent: [commands.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands.md).

## Keynote Commands

### GetKeynoteTree

Retrieves the whole keynote folder and item hierarchy. The technical root folder is not included in the output; the top-level folders and items are returned directly. Available from Archicad 28.

Group: Keynote Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.6. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetKeynoteTree

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `foldersInRoot` (array of KeynoteFolderDetails, required): The top-level keynote folders with their content recursively. The technical root folder itself is not included.
- `itemsInRoot` (array of KeynoteItemDetails, required): The keynote items located directly in the technical root folder.

Grasshopper: `GetKeynoteTreeComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/GetKeynoteTree.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/GetKeynoteTree.py): Prints the keynote folders and items of the project as an indented tree, using GetKeynoteTree. Requires Archicad 28 or later.

### GetKeynoteAutoTexts

Retrieves the autotext tokens of the given keynote items. The tokens can be used as label text content to reference the fields of a keynote item. Available from Archicad 28.

Group: Keynote Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.6. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetKeynoteAutoTexts

Parameters:

- `keynoteItems` (array of KeynoteItemIdArrayItem, required): The keynote items to get the autotext tokens for.

Returns:

- `autoTexts` (KeynoteAutoTextTokensOrErrors, required)

Grasshopper: `GetKeynoteAutoTextsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/GetKeynoteAutoTexts.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/GetKeynoteAutoTexts.py): Creates a keynote item and prints the autotext tokens that reference its fields, with GetKeynoteAutoTexts. Deletes the keynote item at the end. Requires Archicad 28 or later.

### CreateKeynoteFolders

Creates keynote folders under the given parent folders (or under the root folder). Available from Archicad 28.

Group: Keynote Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.6. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateKeynoteFolders

Parameters:

- `foldersData` (array of object, required): Array of data to create keynote folders.
  - `parentFolderId` (KeynoteFolderId): The parent folder. Optional; defaults to the root folder.
  - `key` (string, required)
  - `title` (string, required)

Returns:

- `keynoteFolderIdsOrErrors` (KeynoteFolderIdsOrErrors, required)

Grasshopper: `CreateKeynoteFoldersComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/CreateKeynoteFolders.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/CreateKeynoteFolders.py): Creates a keynote folder with a subfolder in it, using CreateKeynoteFolders. Deletes the folders at the end. Requires Archicad 28 or later.

### CreateKeynoteItems

Creates keynote items in the given parent folders (or in the root folder). Available from Archicad 28.

Group: Keynote Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.6. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateKeynoteItems

Parameters:

- `itemsData` (array of object, required): Array of data to create keynote items.
  - `parentFolderId` (KeynoteFolderId): The parent folder. Optional; defaults to the root folder.
  - `key` (string, required)
  - `title` (string)
  - `description` (string)
  - `reference` (string)

Returns:

- `keynoteItemIdsOrErrors` (KeynoteItemIdsOrErrors, required)

Grasshopper: `CreateKeynoteItemsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/CreateKeynoteItems.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/CreateKeynoteItems.py): Creates a keynote folder with a keynote item in it, using CreateKeynoteItems. Deletes the folder and the item at the end. Requires Archicad 28 or later.

### ModifyKeynoteFolders

Modifies the key, title or reference of the given keynote folders. Available from Archicad 28.

Parameters:

- `foldersData` (array of object, required): Array of data to modify keynote folders. Only provided fields are changed.
  - `keynoteFolderId` (KeynoteFolderId, required)
  - `key` (string)
  - `title` (string)
  - `reference` (string)

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `ModifyKeynoteFoldersComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/ModifyKeynoteFolders.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/ModifyKeynoteFolders.py): Creates a keynote folder and changes its title with ModifyKeynoteFolders. Deletes the folder at the end. Requires Archicad 28 or later.

### DeleteKeynoteFolders

Deletes the given keynote folders including their content. Available from Archicad 28.

Group: Keynote Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.6. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#DeleteKeynoteFolders

Parameters:

- `keynoteFolderIds` (array of KeynoteFolderIdArrayItem, required): The keynote folders to delete.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `DeleteKeynoteFoldersComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/DeleteKeynoteFolders.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/DeleteKeynoteFolders.py): Creates a keynote folder and deletes it with DeleteKeynoteFolders. Deleting a folder deletes its content too. Requires Archicad 28 or later.

### CreateKeynoteLabels

Creates Label elements that reference the given keynote items via autotext. Available from Archicad 28.

Group: Keynote Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.6. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateKeynoteLabels

Parameters:

- `labelsData` (array of object, required): Array of data to create keynote labels.
  - `keynoteItemId` (KeynoteItemId, required)
  - `position` (Coordinate2D, required): The reference point of the label.
  - `contentFields` (array of string ("Key", "Title", "Description", "Reference")): The keynote fields to include in the label text as autotext. Optional; defaults to all fields.

Returns:

- `elements` (ElementIdsOrErrors, required)

Grasshopper: `CreateKeynoteLabelsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/CreateKeynoteLabels.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Keynote/CreateKeynoteLabels.py): Creates a keynote item and places a Label showing its key and title with CreateKeynoteLabels. Deletes the label and the keynote item at the end. Requires Archicad 28 or later.

## Shared schema definitions

Types that parameters and results refer to by name.

### ElementIdArrayItem

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)

### ElementIdOrError

ElementIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: An element identifier or an error.

### ElementIdsOrErrors

array of ElementIdOrError: A list of element identifiers or errors.

### ElementId

object: The identifier of an element.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### KeynoteFolderId

object: The identifier of a keynote folder.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### KeynoteItemId

object: The identifier of a keynote item.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### KeynoteFolderIdArrayItem

object
- `keynoteFolderId` (KeynoteFolderId, required)

### KeynoteItemIdArrayItem

object
- `keynoteItemId` (KeynoteItemId, required)

### KeynoteFolderIdOrError

KeynoteFolderIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A keynote folder identifier or an error.

### KeynoteFolderIdsOrErrors

array of KeynoteFolderIdOrError: A list of keynote folder identifiers or errors.

### KeynoteItemIdOrError

KeynoteItemIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A keynote item identifier or an error.

### KeynoteItemIdsOrErrors

array of KeynoteItemIdOrError: A list of keynote item identifiers or errors.

### KeynoteAutoTextTokens

object: The autotext tokens of a keynote item. A token can be used as the text content of a label to reference the field of the keynote item.
- `keyToken` (string, required)
- `titleToken` (string, required)
- `descriptionToken` (string, required)
- `referenceToken` (string, required)

### KeynoteAutoTextTokensOrError

KeynoteAutoTextTokens or ErrorItem: The autotext tokens of a keynote item or an error.

### KeynoteAutoTextTokensOrErrors

array of KeynoteAutoTextTokensOrError: A list of keynote autotext tokens or errors.

### KeynoteItemDetails

object: The details of a keynote item.
- `keynoteItemId` (KeynoteItemId, required)
- `key` (string, required)
- `title` (string, required)
- `description` (string, required)
- `reference` (string, required)
- `uiText` (string, required)

### KeynoteFolderDetails

object: The details of a keynote folder, including its subfolders and items recursively.
- `keynoteFolderId` (KeynoteFolderId, required)
- `key` (string, required)
- `title` (string, required)
- `reference` (string, required)
- `uiText` (string, required)
- `subFolders` (array of KeynoteFolderDetails, required)
- `items` (array of KeynoteItemDetails, required)

### Guid

string: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

### Coordinate2D

object: 2D coordinate.
- `x` (number, required): X value of the coordinate.
- `y` (number, required): Y value of the coordinate.

### Error

object: The details of an error.
- `code` (integer, required): The code of the error.
- `message` (string, required): The error message.

### ErrorItem

object
- `error` (Error, required)

### SuccessfulExecutionResult

object: The result of a successful execution.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)

### FailedExecutionResult

object: The result of a failed execution.
- `success` (boolean (false), required)
- `error` (Error, required)

### ExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of the execution.

### ExecutionResults

array of ExecutionResult: A list of execution results.
